lines.text: عربیه اول تتبع و استقراء کلام عرب کرده اند و در ثانی الحال بجهته ضبط قواعد صرف و نحو دلایل
lines.en: Arabic, first they have investigated and induced the speech of the Arabs, and secondly, currently, for the sake of recording the rules of morphology and syntax, the proofs

lines.text: عالم کنند و کوکب سرطان طالع عالمست و نکات مستحسنه بجهته اینمعنی است در مداخل خود مذکور
lines.en: of the world they make, and the star of Cancer is the ascendant of the world, and the approved points for this meaning are mentioned in their own introductions.

lines.text: ساخته اند و اعتبار اشراف از بیوت طالع اسمانی ایراد نموده همچنین اهل احکام بعد از تجربه
lines.en: They have made and adduced the consideration of the exaltations from the houses of the celestial ascendant; likewise, the people of judgments, after experience

lines.text: و قیاس دلایل و چون اوتاد ان زایجه که طالع و عاشر و سابع و رابع است مر این بروج منقلبه اند
lines.en: and analogy of the proofs, and since the angles of that horoscope, which are the ascendant, the tenth, the seventh, and the fourth, are for these cardinal signs,

lines.text: سزاوار انست که شرف شمس و کواکب علویه که ابهار سیاره اند و در این بروج نامقامت
lines.en: it is fitting that the exaltation of the Sun and the superior planets, which are the seas of the planets, and in these signs is the place of

lines.text: ان انقلاب کنند پس شرف مشتري که کوکب هیئات و نفاست لایق آنست که در سرطان
lines.en: their revolution, they make. Thus, the exaltation of Jupiter, which is the planet of forms and preciousness, is worthy to be in Cancer,

lines.text: باشد که وتد طالع عالم است چه طالع متعلق بجهد و نفس است و شرف فتاب که پادشاه
lines.en: which is the angle of the ascendant of the world, because the ascendant is related to effort and the soul, and the exaltation of the Sun, which is the king of

lines.text: کواکب است مناسب انست که در حمل باشد که بیت عاشر است چه عاشر اعلی بیوت و متعلق
lines.en: the planets, is appropriate to be in Aries, which is the tenth house, because the tenth is the highest of the houses and is related

lines.text: است بحکومت و دولت و شرف زحل که کوکب دهقت و فلاحت موافق آنست که در میزان
lines.en: to government and state, and the exaltation of Saturn, which is the planet of agriculture and farming, is agreeable to be in Libra,

lines.text: باشد که بیت رابع است چه رابع خانه ضیاع و عقار است و شرف مریخ که کوکب مخالفت و
lines.en: which is the fourth house, because the fourth is the house of estates and lands, and the exaltation of Mars, which is the planet of opposition and

lines.text: عداوتست قیاس انست که در جدي باشد که بیت سابع است چه بیت سابع بیت اضداد و
lines.en: enmity, the analogy is that it should be in Capricorn, which is the seventh house, because the seventh house is the house of opposites and

lines.text: خصومت است و شرف قمر که خلیفه و معین افتابست اصل آنست که در جوزا شرف او باشد پس
lines.en: hostility, and the exaltation of the Moon, which is the deputy and helper of the Sun, the principle is that its exaltation should be in Gemini, thus

lines.text: ثور که مجاور حمل است شرف قمر بود چون زهره سعد است و کوکب نظافت و نزاهت و بیت
lines.en: Taurus, which is adjacent to Aries, became the exaltation of the Moon. Since Venus is a benefic and the planet of cleanliness and purity, and the house

lines.text: نهم متعلق است بدیانت و تقوي و طهارت باید که خانه نهم که برج حوتست شرف او باشد
lines.en: of the ninth is related to religion, piety, and purity, it must be that the ninth house, which is the sign of Pisces, is its exaltation.

lines.text: و شرف عطارد که کوکب عقل و علم و فراست و کیاست است سزاوار انست که در سنبله باشد
lines.en: And the exaltation of Mercury, which is the planet of intellect, knowledge, sagacity, and shrewdness, is fitting to be in Virgo,

lines.text: که برج ارضي است و بیت ثالث است چه بیت ثالث متعلق است بعلم و ادب و تعلیم و تعلم
lines.en: which is an earthy sign and the third house, because the third house is related to knowledge, literature, teaching, and learning.

lines.text: و چون موضع شرف هر یک از این کواکب ناظر است بطالع و عقدتین قمر از کواکب نیست
lines.en: And since the place of exaltation of each of these planets is aspecting the ascendant, and the two nodes of the Moon are not among the planets,

lines.text: اند اولی انست که شرف ایشان در موضعي باشد که از طالع ساقط باشد و بیوت ساقط دویم
lines.en: it is better that their exaltation be in a place that is cadent from the ascendant, and the cadent houses are the second,

lines.text: و ششم و هشتم و دوازدهم است پس از اینها بیت دوازدهم را بجهته شرف راس اختیار کرده اند
lines.en: the sixth, the eighth, and the twelfth. Thus, from these, they have chosen the twelfth house for the exaltation of the Head (North Node).

summary.headline: Rationale for Planetary Exaltations
summary.text: Astrological rationale for the exaltations of the planets, relating Cancer as the world ascendant and the angular houses to Jupiter in Cancer, the Sun in Aries, Saturn in Libra, Mars in Capricorn, the Moon in Taurus, Venus in Pisces, and Mercury in Virgo. The passage then explains placing the North Node’s exaltation in the cadent twelfth house.
